pages.text:
A port only talks to the single block it touches. Two chassis side by side exchange items when one face has an **active** port and the touching face has a **passive** port: each chassis stays an independent machine with its own lanes.

If a neighbour's chunk is not loaded, the port reports **NEIGHBOR_UNLOADED** and waits. Fieldframe never loads chunks to keep a machine running.
Two **active** ports facing each other both work, but they compete for the same items. Prefer one active and one passive face for a predictable chain.
